lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy6In2 (reduced formula Dy3In) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy centers with 13 geometric neighbors (10 Dy, 3 In) and In centers with 10 Dy neighbors, over distances of roughly 3.07–3.28 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Dy 13-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Dy and In polyhedra.
